Pedestrian killed in Oakland crash

OAKLAND, Calif. — A 58-year-old man walking across International Boulevard was struck and killed by a sedan late Sunday night, the Oakland Police Department said.

The crash happened around 11:40 p.m. near 23rd Avenue. The driver remained at the scene and cooperated with investigators, police said. The pedestrian was pronounced dead at the scene.

No arrests have been made. Police said the investigation is continuing and asked anyone with information to contact the traffic division. International Boulevard has been the site of several serious collisions this year.
